'''Vark Street''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. It was the location of [[The Strip]], a section of the street that contained seven [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] that commonly catered to [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]] stationed on the planet.<ref name="Plant" />
